exposure: neonatal birth weight more than 4,000 g
physician experience with operative vaginal delivery
outcome: Failed operative vaginal delivery (cesarean birth after failed operative vaginal delivery)
cohort: Individuals with nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex (NTSV) births who underwent attempted operative vaginal delivery
finding: Failed operative vaginal deliveries were more likely with older maternal age, higher body mass index, obstructed labor, neonatal birth weight over 4,000 g, and lower physician experience with operative vaginal delivery, particularly for forceps attempts.
mod_finding: Physician experience was associated with operative vaginal delivery success, more notably for forceps attempts.
